notes.sowing: Plant divisions of 4 to 6 bulbs in early spring, {cm:15} to {cm:20} apart. From seed, sow several seeds per cell indoors 6 to 8 weeks before your last frost, or sow outdoors {cm:0.6} deep once the soil warms. Seed is slow to make a usable clump.
notes.care: Grows in sun or part shade in any well-drained soil. Water in dry spells and divide clumps every 3 to 4 years to keep them vigorous. Fully hardy; the leaves die back in winter and regrow in spring.
notes.harvest: Snip leaves about {cm:3} above the soil as needed from spring to fall, lightly in the first year from seed. The flowers are edible: pick them just as they open.
